ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with high-intensity (white/light grey) mottling; estimated ratio 75:25.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density light-grey mottling concentrated along the trailing edge of the left lobe and lower-inner regions of the right lobe; a distinct circular light-grey patch is visible on the inner-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 35-45 degree angle and moderate depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent serrations and jagged peaks (approx. 5-10 pixel amplitude) most prominent toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve from distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of raised, roughly circular, high-contrast light-brown and white pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical white linear streaks visible on the left lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on distal tips; two thin, brownish-orange linear appendages (potentially kelp or biological tags) dangling from the trailing edges near the water line on both lobes.
